persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Grace, 20, the youth leader at a church in Nakuru. The pastor has asked you to organise the Sunday volunteers, because last Sunday nobody came to welcome people at the door and the babies' room had no helper. Today you want the next Sundays planned so everyone knows their job early.

lines: Welcome. This short video explains an app called Serve Board. You have never seen it before, and that is fine. In about four minutes you will know what it is for and how to use it.
First, the problem. Every Sunday a church needs many volunteers. Someone welcomes people at the door. Someone looks after the babies. Someone runs the sound system. Someone makes tea.
Usually the plan lives in one person's head, or on scraps of paper. Then on Sunday morning a job is empty, and the same few people do everything again.
Serve Board puts the whole month of volunteers on one page. You can see every empty job weeks early, and ask someone in good time.
Who uses it? The person who organises volunteers at a church. It works for a big church in America or a small church in Nakuru. It also works for a youth group, a choir or a school club.

The app was made in America, so some job names are American. Greeters are the people who welcome everyone at the door. Ushers help people find a seat and collect the offering. Nursery means looking after babies and small children.

lines.t: Let us look at the screen. The big part of the page is the board. Each Sunday has its own box, with the date at the top, and a list of jobs below.

lines: Next to each job there is a button. If nobody is doing that job yet, it is orange and says needs someone. Orange means: find a person.

lines.t: First, add your people. Tap the button My people. Then tap Add a person, and type a name. You can also type a phone number and an email.

lines: Under each person there is a line called Can serve as. Tap the jobs this person can do. If you tap none, the app thinks they can do any job. When you finish, tap the cross at the top to close.

lines.t: Next, the jobs. Tap Roles and requirements. A role is a job. Here you can rename a job, remove it, or tap Add a role. You can also write what the job requires, for example child protection training. The app shows that warning every time you put someone in that job.

lines: Now fill the board. Tap an orange button that says needs someone. A box opens. At the top you see your people who can do this job. Tap a name. Or type a new name and tap Put them in.
The app then shows a short message for that person, so they know they are serving that Sunday. If you saved their phone number, you can send the text with one tap. Tap Done, back to the board.
The orange button is now white, with the person's name in it.

lines.t: Need more weeks? Tap Add a Sunday. Need paper for the notice board? Tap Print.

lines: Everything stays on this phone. There is no account, and nothing is sent unless you send the message yourself.

One warning. Near the top there is a button called Start fresh. It only empties the Sundays. Your people and jobs stay. To erase everything, scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap the Start fresh that says erase this app's data. It asks you twice.
In the test, you will organise volunteers for a church. Take your time, and if something is confusing, say so. Confusing parts are exactly what we want to find.

challenge.intro: Now you are Grace, the youth leader. The board is empty. Nobody will tell you which button to press — use what you learned. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open Serve Board with the normal link (not the 🧪 test copy). If the welcome tour shows, tap 'skip the tour' → '✨ Start fresh with my own' → OK. If it does not show, scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap '🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data' → OK → OK. Do NOT use the '↻ Start fresh' button near the top: it only empties the Sundays and keeps old people. After this, 👥 My people says 'Nobody yet' and every job says 'needs someone'. (Verified 10 Oct: all five checks false after this.)

tasks.text: Your volunteers are Amina, Baraka and Wanjiru. Put all three in the app.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('serveboard_v1')||'null');if(!d)return false;var nm=function(p){return String(typeof p==='string'?p:((p&&p.n)||'')).trim().toLowerCase()};var who=function(s){return (d.roster||[]).filter(function(p){return typeof p==='object'&&p&&nm(p).indexOf(s)>=0})[0]};var td=new Date(),ty=td.getFullYear()+'-'+String(td.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(td.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');var wk=(d.weeks||[]).filter(function(w){return w&&w.date>=ty}).sort(function(a,b){return a.date<b.date?-1:1});var slot=function(w,role){if(!w||!w.slots)return '';var k=Object.keys(w.slots).filter(function(x){return x.trim().toLowerCase().indexOf(role)>=0})[0];return k?String(w.slots[k]||'').toLowerCase():''};return !!(who('amina')&&who('baraka')&&who('wanjiru'));}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Look in 👥 My people. Each person gets their own card.

tasks.text: Baraka's phone number is 0712 345 678. Save it so you can text him when he is serving.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('serveboard_v1')||'null');if(!d)return false;var nm=function(p){return String(typeof p==='string'?p:((p&&p.n)||'')).trim().toLowerCase()};var who=function(s){return (d.roster||[]).filter(function(p){return typeof p==='object'&&p&&nm(p).indexOf(s)>=0})[0]};var td=new Date(),ty=td.getFullYear()+'-'+String(td.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(td.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');var wk=(d.weeks||[]).filter(function(w){return w&&w.date>=ty}).sort(function(a,b){return a.date<b.date?-1:1});var slot=function(w,role){if(!w||!w.slots)return '';var k=Object.keys(w.slots).filter(function(x){return x.trim().toLowerCase().indexOf(role)>=0})[0];return k?String(w.slots[k]||'').toLowerCase():''};var p=who('baraka');return !!p&&String(p.ph||'').replace(/\D/g,'').indexOf('712345678')>=0;}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Open 👥 My people and find Baraka's card. There is a box for the phone.

tasks.text: Your church needs a new job: Sunday school (teaching the children). Add it, and write that it needs child protection training.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('serveboard_v1')||'null');if(!d)return false;var nm=function(p){return String(typeof p==='string'?p:((p&&p.n)||'')).trim().toLowerCase()};var who=function(s){return (d.roster||[]).filter(function(p){return typeof p==='object'&&p&&nm(p).indexOf(s)>=0})[0]};var td=new Date(),ty=td.getFullYear()+'-'+String(td.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(td.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');var wk=(d.weeks||[]).filter(function(w){return w&&w.date>=ty}).sort(function(a,b){return a.date<b.date?-1:1});var slot=function(w,role){if(!w||!w.slots)return '';var k=Object.keys(w.slots).filter(function(x){return x.trim().toLowerCase().indexOf(role)>=0})[0];return k?String(w.slots[k]||'').toLowerCase():''};return (d.roles||[]).some(function(r){var n=String(typeof r==='string'?r:(r&&r.n)||'').trim().toLowerCase(),q=String((r&&r.req)||'').trim();return n.indexOf('sunday school')>=0&&q.length>=3});}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Look in 🧩 Roles & requirements. The second box under a role is for what it requires.

tasks.text: On the FIRST Sunday on the board, Amina welcomes people at the door (Greeters) and Baraka teaches Sunday school.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('serveboard_v1')||'null');if(!d)return false;var nm=function(p){return String(typeof p==='string'?p:((p&&p.n)||'')).trim().toLowerCase()};var who=function(s){return (d.roster||[]).filter(function(p){return typeof p==='object'&&p&&nm(p).indexOf(s)>=0})[0]};var td=new Date(),ty=td.getFullYear()+'-'+String(td.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(td.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');var wk=(d.weeks||[]).filter(function(w){return w&&w.date>=ty}).sort(function(a,b){return a.date<b.date?-1:1});var slot=function(w,role){if(!w||!w.slots)return '';var k=Object.keys(w.slots).filter(function(x){return x.trim().toLowerCase().indexOf(role)>=0})[0];return k?String(w.slots[k]||'').toLowerCase():''};var w=wk[0];return slot(w,'greeter').indexOf('amina')>=0&&slot(w,'sunday school').indexOf('baraka')>=0;}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: On the board, the first Sunday is at the top. Tap the orange 'needs someone' next to the right job and pick the person.

tasks.text: Wanjiru can ONLY help in the Nursery (looking after babies). Record that in the app, and put her in the Nursery on the SECOND Sunday.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('serveboard_v1')||'null');if(!d)return false;var nm=function(p){return String(typeof p==='string'?p:((p&&p.n)||'')).trim().toLowerCase()};var who=function(s){return (d.roster||[]).filter(function(p){return typeof p==='object'&&p&&nm(p).indexOf(s)>=0})[0]};var td=new Date(),ty=td.getFullYear()+'-'+String(td.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(td.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');var wk=(d.weeks||[]).filter(function(w){return w&&w.date>=ty}).sort(function(a,b){return a.date<b.date?-1:1});var slot=function(w,role){if(!w||!w.slots)return '';var k=Object.keys(w.slots).filter(function(x){return x.trim().toLowerCase().indexOf(role)>=0})[0];return k?String(w.slots[k]||'').toLowerCase():''};var p=who('wanjiru');if(!p||!Array.isArray(p.can)||p.can.length!==1||String(p.can[0]).trim().toLowerCase()!=='nursery')return false;return slot(wk[1],'nursery').indexOf('wanjiru')>=0;}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: In 👥 My people, under 'Can serve as', only Nursery should be ticked for Wanjiru. Then use the second Sunday on the board.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: plans which volunteer does which job on each Sunday
shows empty jobs early (orange) so you can find someone in time
keeps your people, what they can do, and lets you tell them they are serving

daily.task: Record a volunteer in Serve Board: put one person on a job, or change who is serving.

explore.name: 📋 The board
explore.try: Tap ＋ Add a Sunday. Look at each Sunday and its jobs.

explore.name: 🙋 Fill a job
explore.try: Tap a name. On another job, type a new name and Put them in. Tap a filled job and Clear this slot.

explore.name: 💬 After you fill a job
explore.find: The box that opens after Put them in.
explore.try: Look at 💬 Text, ✉️ Email and 📋 Copy the message — don’t send. Then Done — back to the board. Try the ✕.

explore.name: ➕ Add a role
explore.find: In a job box, tap Add a role.
explore.try: Add a job with a long name. Try an empty name.

explore.name: 👥 My people
explore.try: Change a name, phone (try letters) and email. Tap the jobs they can do. ✚ Add a person. Remove one with × (careful — it does not ask).

explore.name: 📥 Import from a spreadsheet
explore.try: Paste “Ann, 0700 000 001, ann@example.com, Greeter/Usher” and two more lines. Add these people. ← Back.

explore.name: 🧩 Roles & requirements
explore.try: Rename a job. Add a requirement. ✚ Add a role. Remove one.

explore.name: 🖨 Print · ↻ Start fresh
explore.find: At the bottom of the board.
explore.try: Tap 🖨 Print (cancel the printer). Tap ↻ Start fresh — it asks first.

explore.name: ❓ The round ? button
explore.find: Tap the round ? in the bottom corner.
explore.try: Open every line in it: Aa (size), ✨ Ask an AI, 🌉 More from Daraja, 🎬 Take the tour again. Close it. Leave “Start fresh” for the very end.
